credits.work: Changes to the plate cut-outs of this set
credits.note: All 25: star marks, grid lines and lettering removed and the gaps filled with texture copied from beside them; ink of neighbouring figures removed; figures fitted to the stars; drawing order added. Carina with Puppis and Vela, Hydra and Centaurus are each joined from two or three plates.
